research.title: Preprocessing and Evaluation for Negation-Sensitive Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented assigned preprocessing routines for sentence tokenization and negation marking, following existing specifications for a sentiment classification pipeline.
Ran prescribed classifier comparisons and organized misclassified examples by negation pattern to support review of preprocessing effects.

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Coordination
bullets: Updated inventory logs from receiving documents, checked shipment quantities against purchase orders, and flagged discrepancies for supervisor review.
Prepared order paperwork, maintained filing records, and coordinated pickup arrangements with staff according to established operating procedures.

projects.title: TF-IDF Baselines for News Topic Classification
bullets: Implemented TF-IDF features with logistic regression and multinomial naive Bayes for supervised classification of news articles by topic.
Compared baseline predictions using macro F score and confusion matrices, inspecting errors involving overlapping vocabulary across related news categories.
